explanation: A prophet in the Old Testament who received visions from God about the future.
The chapter in the book of Daniel where he describes a vision he received concerning the end times and world powers.
A symbol representing the powerful Medo-Persian empire, with two horns symbolizing the two kingdoms of Media and Persia.
A symbol representing the Greek empire under Alexander the Great, with a large horn symbolizing his power.
Symbolizes Alexander the Great and his conquests that led to the expansion of the Greek empire.
Represent the four smaller kingdoms that arose after Alexander's death and the division of his empire.
A wicked and powerful horn that grows out from one of the four horns, representing a future tyrannical ruler.
A time period mentioned in Daniel's vision, which can be interpreted as 2300 days or years, and has been subject to various interpretations.
A holy place, often associated with the temple in Jerusalem, that plays a central role in Daniel's vision and end-time events.
An angel who helps Daniel understand the meaning of his vision and explains the symbols and events in detail.
